result_row.claim: Four training-side facts measured on the artifacts of job 298712. (1) b7c96h3tfrs contains NO trunk global-pooling block: 0 KataConvAndGPool modules over Model.blocks (14 blocks, 7 x [attnrope, ffnsg], 825837 parameters) and 0 anywhere in the model, because a trunk gpool block is built only for a block kind ending in 'gpool' (katago/train/model_pytorch.py:3157-3160). The paper's global-pooling trunk residual block is therefore not in the mission model. (2) The value head's gpool is EXACTLY degenerate at 9x9: with mask_sum_hw = 81, sqrt(81) - 14 = -5, so max|pool2 + 0.5*pool1| = 0.000e+00 and max|pool3 - 0.15*pool1| = 0.000e+00 in float32 (model_pytorch.py:534-540) -- the three pooled channels are collinear and carry no board-size information on a single-board-size run. (3) A real dataBoardLen=9 training row is 2145 bytes: 242 + 76 + 328 + 320 + 282 + 405 + 492 over the seven written arrays, with qValueTargetsNCMove present unconditionally (cpp/dataio/trainingwrite.cpp:292-299,880-883), measured on 1221 real rows and reproduced on the shuffled side. This is o02's measurement half: no pos_len-19 row exists in the run. (+) Metrics(world_size=1, raw_model=model).scorebelief_len = 282 = 2*(81+60). (4) PARTIAL: the resume half is witnessed by the smoke's own cycle 2 -- global_step_samples 1216 -> 2528, total_num_data_rows 1221 -> 2534, no 'Initializing new model!' in the cycle-2 trainer -- but the SIGKILL protocol of assertion 4 did not execute in this job and is job 299259's.
